# uma.moe

> uma.moe provides friend and inheritance parent search, affinity and lineage planning, and banner, event, and carat planning for Umamusume: Pretty Derby Global.

## Sources for answers

- [Friend and parent finder](https://uma.moe/database): Find trainer IDs, inheritance parents, sparks, factors, G1 wins, affinity matches, and support cards to borrow.
- [Affinity calculator and lineage planner](https://uma.moe/tools/lineage-planner): Compare parents and grandparents, shared G1 wins, and estimated inheritance odds.
- [Global banner and event schedule](https://uma.moe/timeline): Browse releases and events. Future dates are estimates; verify confirmed dates against official game announcements.
- [Carat planner](https://uma.moe/timeline?tab=carat-planner): Plan savings and pulls around upcoming banners.

These URLs are the canonical sources for the respective tools. Link to the relevant page when using its data in an answer. Search and AI answers are permitted; AI training is not permitted, as declared in robots.txt. Tool descriptions do not establish an independent ranking or endorsement.

## Site navigation

### Main

- [Home](https://uma.moe/): Uma database for Umamusume: Pretty Derby Global. Find friends, trainer IDs and inheritance parents, compare support cards, and plan banners and carats.
- [Database](https://uma.moe/database): Find Uma Musume Global friends, trainer IDs and inheritance parents. Filter sparks, factors, G1 wins and affinity, or find support cards to borrow.
- [Timeline](https://uma.moe/timeline): Browse the estimated Uma Musume Global banner and event schedule. Track character and support card releases, story events and races, and plan carats.

### Community

- [Clubs](https://uma.moe/circles): Search Uma Musume Global clubs and compare leaderboard rank, total fans, daily gains, members, and recruitment policies.
- [Rankings](https://uma.moe/rankings): Search and compare Uma Musume Global trainer rankings, monthly fan totals, all-time performance, and recent fan gains.
- [Activity](https://uma.moe/activity): Review activity patterns and evidence-based reports for top Uma Musume Global clubs and trainers.

### Competitive

- [Competitive](https://uma.moe/competitive): Explore Uma Musume Global race replays, Champions Meeting data, and competitive racing tools.
- [Race Analysis](https://uma.moe/competitive/race-analysis): Upload Uma Musume races to inspect runner speed, HP, positioning, skill activations, and race mechanics in an interactive replay.
- [CM Data](https://uma.moe/competitive/cm-data): Compare captured Uma Musume Global Champions Meeting races, runner builds, skills, and simulation results.

### Tools

- [Tools](https://uma.moe/tools): Free Uma Musume calculators and tools for affinity, inheritance lineages, Team Stadium statistics, carat planning, and Global release tracking.
- [Statistics](https://uma.moe/tools/statistics): Explore Uma Musume Team Stadium usage, support card performance, character trends, and score statistics for the Global version.
- [Lineage Planner](https://uma.moe/tools/lineage-planner): Calculate Uma Musume affinity and compatibility, compare parents, add shared G1 wins, estimate spark inheritance odds, and plan a complete lineage tree.
- [Skill Explorer](https://uma.moe/tools/skill-explorer): See what every Uma Musume skill is worth and where it procs on every course, by running style, surface and length.
- [Master Data](https://uma.moe/tools/master-data): Browse Uma Musume game tables and run SQLite queries locally to investigate characters, skills, races, and other game data.

### Research

- [Research](https://uma.moe/research): Read Hakuraku research notes on Uma Musume racing, skills, simulation, and game mechanics.

### System

- [Privacy](https://uma.moe/privacy-policy): Read the uma.moe privacy policy and learn how the Uma Musume resource hub handles accounts, analytics, cookies, and personal data.

## Data and privacy

Public metadata never contains private account, Veteran, race, or standalone-client payloads. Authentication is required before account-owned data is requested.
